name: DreamHack Stockholm
blurb: Sweden's major gaming festival at Stockholmsmassan, with esports tournaments, an expo, artist alley, tabletop and cosplay competitions.

picks: Rapper; live concert at DreamHack Stockholm

editions.evidence: Stockholm page text: 'November 27 - 29, 2026 ... STOCKHOLMSMASSAN'. The page's own JSON-LD 'Festival' entry carries a stale 2025-11-28 date, which was disregarded in favor of the consistent visible header/body text.

notes: DreamHack Stockholm is a gaming/esports festival rather than a classic guest-signing convention, so only the two headline acts called out on the homepage (bbno$ performing live; hololive hosting livestreams/meet-and-greets) were picked as guests; the Creator Hub likely lists further invited streamers/creators not enumerated here.
